notes.title: Doodle Art Update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

Our new update brings the following:

- we have fixed the issues with the achievements you have had
- we added new categories
- we added new background music; you can now choose from 3 different background sounds from the menu

We hope you'll like these new things. Let us know and leave us a review! We love hearing your feedback!

Have a nice day :)
